description: Synthetic search golden set (MV-4, ranking rank-1, folding fold-1). Every text is invented. Memories are accepted in order; 'expect' is the exact ordered list of labels, 'expect_set' an unordered one, 'projects' the project names reported (exact or ambiguous).

queries.covers: two-character CJK term: bounded substring scan, project rows first
exact project name recalls its memories first; a mention in another project follows
alias recall; a text match ranks above entity-only
ambiguous prefix: both projects reported, nothing merged
ASCII quotes are literal, not phrase syntax
